    Configuration drift

    Snapshot the loaded configs as a baseline, then load a newer set (Clear all, re-upload) and compare to see added/removed rules, interface changes, and new or resolved findings — surfacing access paths that changed over time.

    Simulates lateral movement: what an attacker at this address can reach, then what those hosts can reach in turn (stepping stones).
